risks.risk: Condition is unknown; the set may be worn, scratched, or damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of all surfaces, edges, legs, and interior compartments.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear or damage.

risks.risk: Materials are unknown; it may be MDF or particle board rather than solid wood.
risks.proof: Close-up of material edges and surfaces, or a material specification from the seller.

risks.risk: It is unclear whether the coffee table and TV stand are sold together or separately.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation or listing text stating both pieces are included in one sale.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a single piece until the set is confirmed.

risks.risk: Drawers, doors, and shelves may not work properly.
risks.proof: Video showing drawers opening and closing, doors opening and closing, and shelves holding weight.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-functional or as-is with no working guarantees.

risks.risk: No warranty or return terms are provided.
risks.proof: Written warranty or return policy from the seller.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as as-is with no returns.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the coffee table and TV stand surfaces, edges, and legs.
Video of drawers, doors, and shelves opening and closing.
Confirmation that both pieces are sold together as a set.
Material specification and age of the furniture.
Pickup location in Lagos and delivery terms.
response.reason: The witness identifies a matching black and beige coffee table and TV stand set, model 402, so a worst-case second-hand price can be set; condition, materials, and functionality remain unproven and would raise the value if verified.
